items.title: Reduction of vanishing in all degrees to one vanishing over the maximal pro-l extension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the higher-degree form of the reduction to the maximal pro-l extension: vanishing of the etale cohomology of all l-torsion sheaves over K in degrees at least n is equivalent to the single vanishing of the cohomology of Z/l over the field L fixed by a maximal pro-l subgroup (statement lines 10657-10666). The proof carries out the two directions by translating into Galois cohomology, reducing arbitrary l-torsion coefficients to finite pieces and using the pro-l property of the subgroup (proof lines 10668-10691). The non-formal content is the same reduction as in the degree-n case, now applied in all degrees. The claim is H2: two reductions, both written out.
